description: Held-out Assignment 3 programs in coding styles absent from the development generator: helpers and accumulators, one-liners, mutation, floats, memoisation, guard clauses, prints, wrong names, raising instead of returning. Labels are what a careful instructor would conclude about the misconceptions, not what the probes are expected to find. Hand-written after the grading rules were fixed.

cases.code:
power = lambda b, e: 1 if e == 0 else b * power(b, e - 1)
sum_list = lambda xs: 0 if not xs else xs[0] + sum_list(xs[1:])
